name: Nu-World Holdings Limited
source: UNITS: every figure in this file is in absolute ZAR. The newest column was read from a statement printed in R thousands and multiplied by 1,000 to match the older columns. CRON 20261122: FY2026 column from the issuer reviewed condensed consolidated annual results, year ended 31 August 2026, statement of profit and loss, unit R thousands. Nu-World prints no cost of sales or gross profit line, so those cells and operating expenses are an honest dash. EBIT is the printed net operating income 130,831 less the printed depreciation of 2,008 on property, plant and equipment and 21,728 on right-of-use assets. Net finance costs are the printed finance charges on right-of-use assets 2,461 plus interest paid 1,029. Income before taxation 103,605 less taxation 22,710 equals the printed income after taxation 80,895, which is this column net profit; 150 of share of associate income sits below that line and is excluded, and the printed net profit including it is 81,045. EPS is basic 391.3 cents converted to rand. || Yahoo Finance | CRON 20261025_155306: period columns and blank cells synchronised between the NWL and NWL.JO keys from whichever of the two already held the verified figures (same company name and currency, no value overwritten where the two disagreed); no new figure was collected in this step.
